ideas.children_he: הַתּוֹרָה מְסַפֶּרֶת עַל עוֹלָם שֶׁבּוֹ אֲנָשִׁים חָיוּ בְּלִי לְכַבֵּד גְּבוּלוֹת. גַּם כְּשֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ חֲזָקִים, עָלֵינוּ לְכַבֵּד אֲחֵרִים.
ideas.children_en: Long ago, people had many children. 'Sons of God' took women and giants called Nephilim were born. God gave people 120 years to change because His spirit would not stay with them forever.

ideas.children_he: הָעוֹלָם הִתְמַלֵּא רֶשַׁע, אֲבָל נֹחַ בָּחַר לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹב. גַּם כְּשֶׁרַבִּים מִתְנַהֲגִים לֹא יָפֶה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְחֹר אַחֶרֶת.
ideas.children_en: People did bad things and God was sorry He made them. He planned to destroy all living beings because people ruined creation. But Noah was good and God chose him to save humanity.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ הָיָה אָדָם יָשָׁר בְּעוֹלָם מָלֵא אַלִּימוּת. אֹמֶץ הוּא לִפְעָמִים לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַנָּכוֹן גַּם כְּשֶׁאַתָּה כִּמְעַט לְבַד.
ideas.children_en: Noah was a good man who obeyed God, and he had three sons. But the world was full of violence and stealing. People did not respect each other or follow rules.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים צִוָּה עַל נֹחַ לִבְנוֹת תֵּבָה. כְּשֶׁמִּתְכּוֹנְנִים מֵרֹאשׁ לְסַכָּנָה, אֶפְשָׁר לְהָגֵן עַל חַיִּים.
ideas.children_en: God told Noah the earth was full of violence and would be destroyed. Noah must build a big wooden ark with windows and special walls. It will hold him and his family when the flood starts.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ קִבֵּל הַבְטָחָה שֶׁמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תִּשָּׁמֵר. גַּם בְּזְמַן פַּחַד, הַתִּקְוָה עוֹזֶרֶת לָנוּ לְהַמְשִׁיךְ.
ideas.children_en: God will send a big flood to destroy all living creatures on earth. Noah and his family will go into the ark. God promises to protect them by making a special agreement.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ דָּאַג גַּם לְבַעֲלֵי הַחַיִּים. הָאַחֲרָיוּת שֶׁלָּנוּ אֵינָהּ רַק לַאֲנָשִׁים, אֶלָּא גַּם לַיְּצוּרִים הַחַיִּים.
ideas.children_en: Noah must bring pairs of all animals into the ark so life can continue after the flood. Animals will come to the ark by themselves, but Noah needs to care for them inside.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ אָסַף מָזוֹן וְהֵכִין אֶת הַתֵּבָה. מְשִׂימוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת מַצְלִיחוֹת כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבְהַתְמָדָה.
ideas.children_en: Noah gathered food for himself and all the animals. He did exactly what God told him, and built the ark for many years even though it was hard and difficult.
